## Load the NHANES data

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

nhanes <- read_csv(
  "examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## Preview

```{r}
dim(nhanes)
head(nhanes)
```

## Cohort
```{r}
income_order <- c("Low Income (<1.3)", "Middle Income", "High Income (>3.5)")

analysis_df <- nhanes |>
  filter(Age >= 20, Age <= 80) |>
  mutate(IncomeGroup = factor(IncomeGroup, levels = income_order))

cohort_counts <- tibble(
  step = c("Prepared CSV rows", "Rows after age 20-80 restriction"),
  n = c(nrow(nhanes), nrow(analysis_df))
)

knitr::kable(cohort_counts)
```

## Missingness

```{r}
key_vars <- c("BMI", "Age", "IncomeGroup", "Gender", "Race", "Cycle")

missingness <- tibble(variable = key_vars) |>
  mutate(
    missing_n = vapply(analysis_df[key_vars], function(x) sum(is.na(x)), numeric(1)),
    missing_percent = round(100 * missing_n / nrow(analysis_df), 1)
  )

knitr::kable(missingness)
```


## Table 1 Summary

```{r}
mean_sd <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f)", mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
}

table1 <- analysis_df |>
  filter(!is.na(IncomeGroup)) |>
  group_by(IncomeGroup) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `BMI, mean (SD)` = mean_sd(BMI),
    `Age, mean (SD)` = mean_sd(Age),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    IncomeGroup = factor(
      IncomeGroup,
      levels = c("Low Income (<1.3)", "Middle Income", "High Income (>3.5)")
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(IncomeGroup)

knitr::kable(table1, caption = "Summary by income group")
```

## Methods note

NHANES data for adults aged 20–80 were summarized by income group using BMI and Age. Missing values were checked for BMI, age, income, gender, race, and survey cycle; records missing income were excluded from the summary.
